name: Shadcn Link Pagination
summary: Demo of shadcn pagination navigating with Next.js links and URL search params, with page-size options.
description: A demo site for shadcn/ui pagination that changes the URL through Next.js Link components and search params; navigationMode="router" switches to router.push() with loading indicators. Includes a simple example, one with many pages and page-size options (rows per page).
contains: demo of shadcn/ui pagination driven by Next.js Link components
Link navigation or router.push via navigationMode="router"
updates the URL with search params such as page and page size
examples: simple, many pages, page-size options (rows per page)
